scientific_integrity: General validity derives from conditional-distribution orthogonality and exact total variance; 2,752 rational checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite-dimensional claim. The equality classifications and numerical capacity are derived, not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem requires an independent random response-reflection coin and continuous uniform margins. It concerns population Chatterjee correlation, not finite-sample inference or conditional orientation noise. Its fair-coin concordance conclusion is not asserted for biased coins; earlier Fréchet-mixture special-case endpoint values are prior knowledge. Unindexed equivalent results may exist.
title: Exact rank-reflection attenuation and sharp capacity for bivariate copulas
